environment: Windows 11  (10.0.26200) 64bit; AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics ; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Laptop GPU
method: Saved MuseumStart integration; isolated swept kinematic glove envelope and XRInteractionManager API fixtures; explicit root/window/section ownership and relative-pose checks; separate XRSimulatedController Grip -> saved input actions -> ActionBasedController -> saved physical hand/direct interactor -> helmet/window. Home uses synthetic keyboard input. No scene saves.
limits: Desktop synthetic inputs and explicit API fixtures only. Not real headset/controller tracking, finger tracking, hand comfort, perceived weight, stereo visual acceptance, device performance, accessibility/user research, or an executable build. Collision checks use the simplified box glove envelope spanning the palm and preset finger space, not individual articulated finger colliders. They cover the recorded wall/table fixtures and exercised saved exhibit paths, not absolute nonpenetration for every geometry/speed. API collaboration fixtures use authored local poses and synchronous manager calls; they do not establish physical input usability. Hidden batch frames are paced near 90 Hz; elapsed time is harness time, not a performance benchmark.
